title: ClosureBench: A Benchmark for Reasoning under Closure Assumptions
abstract: arXiv:2611.26335v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) often answer questions from incomplete records. Missing information might be interpreted as unknown or false, depending on the completeness of the source. Current evaluations fail to distinguish these two aspects, as they are usually interwoven with other reasoning demands. We present ClosureBench, a benchmark that tests whether LLMs follow the stated rules for dealing with missing information. Every base scenario is tested under OWA, CWA, and LCWA, and only the treatment of missing information changes between variants. ClosureBench provides a verified base benchmark as well as agent extensions for action choice, source scope, and updates. A model is considered correct on a base scenario only if it provides correct answers in all of its closure variants. Across 960 instances, overall accuracy can mask substantial closure mistakes. Models achieve overall accuracy from 71.18% to 99.86% across

translated_title: ClosureBench：封闭假设下推理的基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）构建的AI智能体经常需要从不完整的记录中回答问题。缺失的信息可能被解释为未知或错误，这取决于信息来源的完整性。当前的评估未能区分这两个方面，因为它们通常与其他推理需求交织在一起。我们提出了ClosureBench，这是一个测试LLM是否遵循所规定的缺失信息处理规则的基准。每个基础场景都在OWA（开放世界假设）、CWA（封闭世界假设）和LCWA（局部封闭世界假设）下进行测试，且各变体之间仅有对缺失信息的处理方式不同。ClosureBench提供了一个经过验证的基础基准，以及针对行动选择、来源范围和更新的智能体扩展。只有当模型在某个基础场景的所有封闭变体中都给出正确答案时，才被认为在该基础场景上是正确的。在960个实例中，总体准确率可能掩盖大量的封闭推理错误。各模型的整体准确率在71.18%到99.86%之间
tldr: ClosureBench是一个通过在OWA、CWA和LCWA三种封闭假设下仅隔离缺失信息处理方式的变化来测试大语言模型是否遵循缺失信息处理规则的基准，并揭示了总体准确率会掩盖大量封闭推理错误的问题。
en_tdlr: ClosureBench is a benchmark that tests whether LLMs follow stated rules for handling missing information by isolating closure assumption variants (OWA, CWA, LCWA), revealing that overall accuracy can mask substantial closure reasoning errors.
